en.description: Returns the current schema version, supported range (min/max), module mode (Normal/ReadOnly/Refused/Unknown), pending migration count, and lock state.
Lists all discoverable migrations (Module, OperatorLocal, Plugin:*) with manifest details and applied/pending status.
Lists migrations strictly above the current schema version, in apply order.
Returns details for a single migration identified by full id, version, or slug.
Dry-run preview: files modified/created/deleted, entity counts before/after, sample diffs. Query: allowNetwork=true to permit network probes for ExternalImport migrations.

Applies a single migration or chain. Body: { target: { id|version }, mode: sync|async, branchMode: InPlace|Branch|BranchAndMerge, allowUnsigned, allowNetwork }. sync + EstimatedDurationSec>10 returns 409 with hint to use async.

bodyFields.name: target
bodyFields.description: Either { id: '21.3.7-add-currency-tag' } for a single migration or { version: '0.3.0' } for a chain to that version (use 'latest' for highest Module-origin version).

en.description: Background job status: { status: Queued|Running|Completed|Failed, progress, log, result }.
Forcibly clears a stale schema lock. Operator must verify no concurrent migration is running.
Pointer-only downgrade to a version in history[]. No migration script runs. Records the downgrade as a schema-restore: history entry.

bodyFields.name: to
bodyFields.description: Target version, must exist in history[].

bodyFields.name: reason
bodyFields.description: Free-text reason recorded in the history entry.
